title: cost-anomaly-triage event payload
description: The app-specific part of a cloud spend-spike alert from an external cost-anomaly detector (RunAgentRequest.payload). The envelope (source, severity, message, timestamp) is validated by ingestion, not here. Extra fields are allowed and passed to the agent as data.

account.description: Cloud account the spend is billed to.

service.description: Service the spend is attributed to; with region, the alert_key and what billing-lookup is asked about.

tags.description: Cost-allocation tags the detector attached. Set by whoever created the resources: claims, not proof.

window_start.description: Start of the flagged window, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

window_end.description: End of the flagged window, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

baseline_cost.description: What the detector expected for the window, in USD.

observed_cost.description: What was actually spent in the window, in USD.

anomaly_level.description: The detector's own grading of how far observed_cost is above baseline_cost. Optional. 'extreme' always escalates (the manifest's escalate_when guardrail), whatever the agent decides: a deterministic check the agent can't lower.
